POST /rosters.summary: Roster one or many duties (all or nothing)
POST /rosters.description:
Refused, with `details.entry_index`, when an entry is outside your scope (`ROSTER_OUT_OF_SCOPE`), overlaps
another duty of the same person (`ROSTER_CONFLICT`, also for a night shift running into the next day), falls
on approved leave (`ROSTER_ON_LEAVE`), is for a past date and you are not HR (`ROSTER_DATE_CLOSED`) or names
someone who is not an active employee (`ROSTER_EMPLOYEE_INACTIVE`). The rostered staff with a login get a
notification; every open planner gets `roster.changed`.
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).

**Required permission:** `roster.manage.all OR roster.manage.nursing OR roster.manage.support`

POST /rosters/copy.description:
Copies the active entries you may manage (optionally one ward / department / staff category). Entries that
would conflict or fall on leave are skipped and listed in `skipped` with the reason; the rest are created.
`rotate_days` (e.g. 1 on a Monday-Sunday week) moves each person's days on, so rest days rotate through the week
and no one is always off, or always on, on a Sunday.

GET /rosters/week.summary: Week check: rest days per person, staff per day and shift
GET /rosters/week.description:
One roster week (it starts on setting `roster_week_start_day`) for the staff you may see: each person's
`duty_dates`, `rest_dates` and `leave_dates`; `NoRestDay` when they work more days than the week allows (fewer
rest days than `weekly_rest_days`: each day beyond is paid as extra duty) and `NotRostered` for roster-only
staff with no duty yet. `days`: how many are on duty, on leave and resting each day, and per shift, so a thin
Sunday shows before the week starts. With `ward_id`: the staff with a duty on that ward and its duties only.

**Required permission:** `roster.manage.all OR roster.manage.nursing OR roster.manage.support OR roster.view.all`

POST /rosters/swaps.summary: Record a swap agreed on the ward (staff without a login)
POST /rosters/swaps.description:
For staff who cannot use self-service (sweepers, guards): the two agreed in person, you record it and the
roster changes at once (accepted and approved by you; you cannot be one of the two: `SWAP_SELF_APPROVAL`). The same
checks as a request apply: both duties not started (`SWAP_DUTY_STARTED`), same staff category
(`SWAP_COLLEAGUE_INELIGIBLE`), each free for the other's duty (`ROSTER_CONFLICT`, `ROSTER_ON_LEAVE`).
`ROSTER_OUT_OF_SCOPE`: you may not roster this employee (outside your staff scope).

**Required permission:** `roster.manage.all OR roster.manage.nursing OR roster.manage.support`

**Required permission:** `roster.manage.all OR roster.manage.nursing OR roster.manage.support`
